_comment: TD-FUT-082. The licence policy scripts/check-licences.py applies to the CycloneDX SBOM CI generates for the image. The class of a licence is decided by the script from its text; this file holds only what a person decided: which classes fail for which kind of component, which components are Clavaris's own code, the licences an artefact's metadata omits (with where each was read), and reviewed exceptions. Every override and exception needs a reason or a source, and a date; one without is refused.

failOnClass._comment: Strong copyleft is refused for the Java libraries Clavaris links against, and allowed for operating-system packages, which are separate programs the image aggregates rather than links. Network copyleft, source-available and non-commercial terms are refused for everything: they are what a customer's legal team asks about.

firstParty._comment: Clavaris's own modules: proprietary (see LICENSE), listed in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md as nothing because they are not third-party.
